messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Git bisect is the bomb!
parts:
I can't get over how wonderful that was. Thanks again,
Ben.

With the bisection, a quick diff on the breaking commit and
the previous commit quickly isolated the problem. It had
baffled me while just squinting at it and the overall diff versus
the previous tag was just too big to get a handle one.

To clear the record, I introduced the origial bug, not
Marcus. I did it when I was trying to clean out the references
to std::cout and std::cerr and get warnings (for int divisions)
to print.

- Bob
